Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our top favorites are BOOST X Dry Shampoo ($34.00) and 00 Clear Super Gloss Glossing Treatment ($30.00).
BOOST X Dry Shampoo is ideal if you want a quick root refresh between wash days. It absorbs excess oil with ultra-fine rice starch, delivers scalp care with saw palmetto extract, and adds weightless volume without grittiness or white cast.
00 Clear Super Gloss Glossing Treatment is best if your main focus is boosting shine, softness, and overall hair health. It delivers salon-quality gloss right at home to leave your strands looking extra radiant.
If you want to refresh oily roots instantly on no-wash days, BOOST X is your best pick. If you want high-impact shine and hydration for your strands, 00 Clear Super Gloss is the way to go!
